SELECT , (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(d.dict_label ORDER BY d.dict_sort SEPARATOR ',') FROM expert_major em LEFT JOIN sys_dict_data d ON d.dict_type = 'expert_major' AND d.dict_value = em.major_code WHERE em.expert_id = e.id) AS major_names FROM expert_info e WHERE e.del_flag = '0'
AND e.expert_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.expertName}, '%')
AND e.company_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.companyName}, '%')
AND e.region_code = #{query.regionCode}
AND e.status = #{query.status}
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM expert_major em2 WHERE em2.expert_id = e.id AND em2.major_code = #{query.majorCode})
ORDER BY e.id DESC
